recovery_spec.key_matching: token boundaries only; multi-character keys case-insensitive, single-character keys exact (case-insensitive only inside explicit answer statements)
recovery_spec.explicit_preference: the LAST unambiguous explicit answer statement wins; negated and disjunctive statements never recover
recovery_spec.final_line_key: the FULL final non-empty line stripped of markdown wrappers/punctuation is EXACTLY one allowed key: recognised before the ambiguity check and outranking earlier explicit statements; never a final-word/last-letter guess
recovery_spec.ambiguity: two or more distinct isolated key mentions recover nothing
recovery_spec.reasoning_channel: only when content is empty; explicit statements over full reasoning, else unique isolated key in the trailing 40 chars
